subject: translate left-censored data analysis BUGs model to R-INLA

messages.author: a3ed0042116ab129
messages.subject: translate left-censored data analysis BUGs model to R-INLA
parts:
Dear users,

I am very new to R-INLA and still reading to understand r-inla.  I have a simple BUGS model for left-censored data analysis that I wonder if it is possible to translate to inla code.
There isn't an example for this case.

model{

# likelihood function
   for(i in 1:M){
      Y[i] ~ dnorm(mu, tau)C(,Y.cen[i])
   }

# prior 
   tau <- 1/(sigma*sigma)  

   mu ~ dnorm(0, 0.001)  
   sigma ~ dunif(sigma_min, sigma_max) 
   est_GM <- exp(mu)
   est_GSD <- exp(sigma)

}

Thank you for your help.
Tran
